# Mastering Mistral AI: A Guide on How to Use Mistral AI Effectively

Mistral AI offers models for chat, code, documents, speech and embeddings, many with open weights. Learn how to pick one, call it and run it yourself.

![](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/jVM-KROtc4Q/hqdefault.jpg)

Watch: a browser integration illustrates why privacy commitments and offline inference are different questions.

Mistral AI builds efficient, production-ready large language models with an architecture that emphasizes throughput, quality and control. The company's work in generative AI covers chat and reasoning, code, document understanding, speech and embeddings, so you can start with a general-purpose Mistral model and add specialist models only when a task needs them.

Mistral's lineup spans compact checkpoints for edge inference and very large mixture-of-experts models for high-quality generation in the cloud. Unlike most frontier labs, Mistral publishes open weights for many of its flagship models, so the same model you call through a hosted endpoint can often be downloaded and run on your own infrastructure. The models generate text, structured outputs or embeddings in response to user prompts, and several of them accept images as input.

A core promise is control: you choose where models run, how prompts are stored and which parameters govern behavior. This guide was updated on October 30, 2026 to reflect the current lineup, including Mistral Large 4, Mistral Medium 3.5 and Mistral Small 4, the rename of Le Chat to Vibe, the Studio developer console that grew out of La Plateforme, and the licenses that decide what you can self-host. Treat prices and plan details as a snapshot and confirm them in the official documentation.

## Understanding Mistral AI

Mistral AI was founded in April 2023 by Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample and Timothée Lacroix, according to the company's [about page](https://mistral.ai/about?ref=cognativ.com). At a high level, Mistral focuses on efficient training and inference: sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures that activate only a fraction of their parameters per token, careful data curation and optimized serving stacks. The goal is high quality at a favorable cost per token.

The ecosystem has three main entry points, and two of them have new names since this guide was first published:

*   **Vibe (formerly Le Chat).** Mistral's assistant for people, available on the web at chat.mistral.ai and on mobile. Mistral announced that "Le Chat is now Vibe" on May 28, 2026, with a Work mode for multi-step tasks and a Code mode for remote coding sessions.
*   **Studio (formerly La Plateforme).** The developer console at console.mistral.ai, where you create API keys, test models, review usage and configure agents.
*   **Open-weight models.** Checkpoints published on Hugging Face that you can deploy on-premises, in your own cloud account or at the edge, under the license attached to each model.

Most Mistral models are multilingual. Mistral positions its models for European and global user bases, and in practice the larger models handle major European and Asian languages, including French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese. Language quality still varies by model size and domain, so evaluate on your own content rather than relying on a general claim.

### How Mistral differs from other LLM providers

Three traits set Mistral apart. First, it releases open weights for many frontier-class models rather than only for small ones. Second, it offers regional processing: Mistral's [August 2026 infrastructure announcement](https://mistral.ai/news/regional-inference-open-models-new-compute/?ref=cognativ.com) describes generally available regional endpoints that keep processing in Europe or the US, with limited safeguarded transfers to sub-processors. Third, its platform now also hosts selected third-party open models, such as Z.ai GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, alongside Mistral's own.

![Three parallel columns: Vibe for people working in chat, Studio and the API for developers, and open weights for self-hosting on your own infrastructure.](https://storage.ghost.io/c/cc/dc/ccdca949-0fe4-4119-8990-70a44ad75060/content/images/2026/10/how-to-use-mistral-ai-1.png)

Mistral has three entry points: Vibe for people, Studio and the API for developers, and open weights you host yourself.

## Mistral AI Model Lineup in October 2026

The table below summarizes the main models on Mistral's [models overview](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/models_overview/?ref=cognativ.com) as of October 30, 2026. Context lengths, parameters and licenses come from the official model cards and announcements linked in this guide.

| Model | Best for | Architecture | Context | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mistral Large 4 (v26.10, public preview) | Hardest reasoning, agentic coding, security and multimodal analysis | MoE, about 1.05T total, 52B active | 1M tokens | Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License |
| Mistral Medium 3.5 (v26.04) | Agentic and coding workloads, general enterprise chat | Dense, 128B | 256k tokens | Modified MIT (open weights) |
| Mistral Small 4 (v26.03) | Fast, low-cost chat, reasoning and coding with image input | MoE, 119B total, about 6B active | 256k tokens | Apache 2.0 |
| Mistral Large 3 (v25.12) | Open general-purpose multimodal model | MoE, 675B total, 41B active | 256k tokens | Apache 2.0 |
| Ministral 3 (3B, 8B, 14B) | Edge and on-device inference | Dense, base, instruct and reasoning variants | 256k tokens (8B card) | Apache 2.0 |
| Codestral (v25.08) | Code completion and fill-in-the-middle | Code model | 128k tokens | Premier (API) |

Beyond the generalist and code models, the catalog includes OCR 4.1 for document intelligence, the Voxtral family for transcription and speech generation, Mistral Embed and Codestral Embed for vectors, Mistral Moderation 2 and the Apache-licensed Shieldstral 1.0 for safety classification, and the Timestral time-series forecasting models. # Exploring Mistral AI: French Startup Revolutionizing Generative Models

[![Andrew Andreev](/media/blogimg/200-200/en/22231c6881c1f86494f24cd904df174e.jpg "Andrew Andreev")](https://apix-drive.com/en/blog/authors/andrew-andreev "Andrew Andreev")

[Andrew Andreev](https://apix-drive.com/en/blog/authors/andrew-andreev "Andrew Andreev")

Author at ApiX-Drive

**Reading time:** ~11 min

The US companies consistently hold the lead among AI product developers. The key ones among them are OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Anthropic. But a French startup, Mistral AI, is confidently trying to establish itself as a key player in the AI industry. We dedicated this article to it. You will learn what Mistral AI is, what technologies it represents on the market, how and where they are used, and what its main differences from competitors are.

**5.** [Final Thoughts](https://apix-drive.com/en/blog/useful/exploring-mistral-ai#final-thoughts)

\*\*\*

## What Is Mistral AI and Why It Matters

Mistral AI is a French startup that produces large language models (LLM). Although it holds a relatively small share of the global AI systems market, its impressive capitalization (over $6 billion) and a significant amount of investment (over $1 billion) have made it the most valuable AI startup in Europe.

The company was founded in April 2023 by three former Google DeepMind and Meta employees: Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample, and Timothée Lacroix. At the time of writing, the first of them is Mistral AI CEO, the second is CSO, and the third is CTO.

![Mistral AI](/media/blogimg/w720/en/64468a84c5bf22a3b317bd3866ea3190.jpg "Mistral AI")

  
The startup received its first funding in June 2023. Its volume amounted to €113 million. The investment round included Lightspeed Venture Partners, JCDecaux, and businessmen Eric Schmidt and Xavier Niel.

In December 2023, the startup managed to raise another €385 million in its second investment round. The top participants included the Andreessen Horowitz fund, the financial group BNP Paribas, and [Salesforce](https://apix-drive.com/en/integrations/salesforce-crm). After that, its estimated value reached $2 billion.

In June 2024, the startup raised a record tranche of €600 million. At that time, the total volume of Mistral AI funding exceeded €1 billion.

Mistral AI's debut product was the open-source Mistral 7B language model, which was released in September 2023. The company then released a more powerful version, LLM Mixtral 8x7B, which outperformed Meta's [Llama 2 70B](https://apix-drive.com/en/blog/useful/exploring-code-llama-by-meta) in a number of ways.

In February 2024, Mistral AI entered into a strategic partnership with Microsoft. In addition to an investment of €15 million, their collaboration involves the launch of the French startup's AI products on the Microsoft Azure platform.

In January 2025, Mistral AI announced a partnership with Agence France-Presse (AFP). It also collaborates with IBM, Orange, and Stellantis, as well as the French Ministry of Defense.

## Core Technologies Behind Mistral AI

Mistral AI has a broad product line. It includes publicly available open-source LLMs (distributed under the free Apache 2.0 license), general-purpose commercial and specialized language models, and the Le Chat chatbot.

**Open-source LLMs:**

*   **Mistral Small 3.** A general-purpose open-source LLM that performs AI-specific tasks with high accuracy (over 81% on MMLU) and low latency (150 tokens/sec). It competes well with larger models (Llama 3.3 70B or Qwen 32B) and could be a good alternative to proprietary LLMs (GPT-4o mini). The latest version of Mistral Small 3 was released in January 2025.
*   **Pixtral 12B.** Mistral's first multimodal model was released in September 2024. It recognizes text and images with 52.5% accuracy on MMMU. This LLM is good at interpreting graphs and charts, answering questions about document content, following instructions, and performing multimodal reasoning. It also supports processing images of any size and quantity using URLs or base64 encoding.

**Premium LLMs:**

*   **Mistral Large 2.** The startup’s flagship model was released in July 2024. It has a context window of 128,000 tokens and can understand queries in 12 natural languages and over 80 programming languages. This LLM efficiently solves complex problems, generating accurate and concise answers. In the field of code generation and mathematical calculations, it outperforms Llama 3.1 405B. In November 2024, its new version, Mistral Large 24.11, was released. They are available through Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, IBM watsonx.ai, and Mistral AI API.
*   **Pixtral Large.** The largest and most powerful multimodal model was released in November 2024. Its context window has 128,000 tokens, allowing it to process at least 30 high-quality images at a time. It interprets images, diagrams, and text documents with high accuracy. It is available under the Mistral Research License (MRL) for educational and scientific purposes, and under the Mistral Commercial License for commercial purposes.
